description: This file contains unit tests for the MembershipTableManager class in the Orleans framework, specifically testing its behavior during silo startup, membership updates, and failure detection in a distributed cluster environment.

classes.name: MembershipTableManagerTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the MembershipTableManager, covering scenarios like startup, membership updates, failure detection, and cluster state changes.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_NewCluster
methods.description: Tests the behavior of MembershipTableManager when starting a new cluster.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_ExistingCluster
methods.description: Tests the behavior of MembershipTableManager when starting with an existing cluster.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Restarted
methods.description: Tests the scenario where a silo restarts with an existing cluster and an older membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Superseded
methods.description: Tests the behavior when a silo has been superseded by a newer iteration.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_AlreadyDeclaredDead
methods.description: Tests the scenario where a silo is already marked dead before startup.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_DeclaredDead_AfterJoining
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo is declared dead after transitioning to joining state.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_ButIAmKill
methods.description: Tests the logic where a silo attempts to suspect another but detects it has already failed.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_AlreadyDead
methods.description: Tests suspect/kill logic when the target silo is already dead.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_DeclareDead_SmallCluster
methods.description: Tests declaring a silo dead in a small cluster with one vote threshold.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_ClocksNotSynchronized
methods.description: Tests cluster behavior when clocks are out of sync, ensuring votes are correctly evaluated.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_DeclareDead_LargerCluster
methods.description: Tests declaring a silo dead in a larger cluster with multiple votes.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Refresh
methods.description: Tests the refresh behavior of the membership table, including retry logic after failures.
